parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with a narrow QRS and very tall precordial voltages (R in V4–V5 about 25–40 mm, deep S in V2–V3, so Sokolow-Lyon is well over 35 mm) plus tall R in aVL and left axis deviation; the ST elevation in V1–V3 is the discordant pattern seen with LVH, with no reciprocal changes or regional pattern that would meet STEMI criteria.
